platform: Windows 11, current machine only; macOS not compiled or run
build: Release Rust host with LTO and embedded production Vite frontend; isolated copy of production source with timing/check instrumentation
workload: 300 synthetic short text records plus a 3840x2160 image; both real preview pages exercised; independent SQLite data and WebView2 profile
shortcut: Temporary Ctrl+Alt+F10 registered through production global-shortcut handling and invoked with Windows SendInput; binding removed on process exit
timing_scope: Input submission to completion of native show/unminimize/focus; frame proxy waits two requestAnimationFrame callbacks, not physical screen capture
sampling: Five actual one-minute hidden/suspend cycles; first cycle also waits another minute and inserts three synthetic background records while suspended
background_scope: Production cleanup/idle/target-capture threads enabled. System clipboard watcher disabled only in test copy; direct independent database insert plus production changed() simulates capture notifications without changing or exposing user clipboard.
memory_scope: Sum of host and all descendant processes. Private working set is private resident physical memory; private commit is private allocation charge, not currently resident RAM.
limitations: This workload and machine only; no low-system-memory stress or prolonged leak test. Physical memory reclamation is delayed and best effort; macOS not verified.
